# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan Continues — His Refusal and Fall

---

**1** 'Michael urged all the angels: "Worship the image of the Lord God — God has commanded it." Michael worshiped first, then turned to me: "Worship the image of God."'

**2** 'But I said: "I refuse to worship Adam." When Michael kept insisting, I said: "Why are you forcing me? I will not bow down to someone who is beneath me and came after me. I existed before that creature — I was made before him. He should be the one worshiping me."'

**3** 'The other angels who heard me also refused to bow down. Michael said: "Worship the image of God. If you don't, the Lord God will be furious with you."'

**4** 'I said: "If God is angry with me, I will set my throne above the stars of heaven and make myself like the Most High."'

**5** 'The Lord God was furious. He commanded that I be thrown out of heaven along with my angels.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
